en.t: There was a boxed lunch in the package.

units.source_text: 还留着温热，三个夹杂着麦粉的饭团，咸沙丁鱼两串，

en.t: It was still warm: three rice balls mixed with barley flour, two skewers of salted sardines,

units.source_text: 干巴巴起皱的腌萝卜，再加上有些苦味的水煮蔬菜……

en.t: some dry, wrinkled pickled radish, and boiled vegetables with a slight bitterness...

units.source_text: 那蔬菜，看着像晒干的萝卜叶子。

en.t: The vegetables looked like dried radish leaves.

units.source_text: 他好容易吃下一串沙丁鱼和一个饭团。

en.t: He managed with difficulty to eat one skewer of sardines and one rice ball.

units.source_text: 胃就像个胶皮手套，冰凉凉的。

en.t: His stomach felt like a rubber glove, cold and clammy.
